## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d7aa2a81f72caefe26bed5596352be758d2ef345`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md, .claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (header comment only)

Read for this record: card #32673 (body and all five comments, ruling record 6840575378 and carrier note 6820982222 among them), ruling A on #32584 (record 6819475461), this PR's body, its file list, its net diff against `main` (three files, +14 −5), and the head's check-runs. Files were read at the head with `git show`. Nothing was built or run.

**Findings: 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix, 4 nits (N1 to N4 in ④).**

### ① Derived judgments

- **No machine accept-set changes. Right.** The diff holds no schema, validator or gate predicate. The token-ratchet hunk is nine comment lines (L171–179) inside the header comment, which spans L4–265. Neither ratchet's `CEILINGS` map is in the diff, and both `.claude` files keep their line counts (35 and 337).
- **What a seat's contract-review record may pass widens in one place. Right.** A PR that adds a key may now raise the token ceiling of the published skill file its enumeration row lands in, with no deletion shown and no ruling per PR. Until now that took deletion of restatement in the same file, or a ruling per case. Record 6840575378 orders exactly this, with four bounds: the row's own measured delta, nothing else cut, no wider raise, both rulings quoted.
- **A retirement PR's file surface widens in one place. Right.** A rename whose replacement is a top-level key or a bound live member now carries that one enumeration row. The playbook said 「⛔ 不进退役 PR」 with no carve-out. A retirement PR that adds the replacement is a PR that adds a key, so this is the exception `lanes/skills.md` L14 already grants on `main`, now also stated in the playbook. The removal direction is untouched: the old name's row keeps the reversed order, as ruling A on #32584 says. Such a PR touches `skills/**` and lands by a human merge. The card states that cost.
- **Public surface: none. Right.** No `skills/**` file, package, schema or docs page is in the diff, and no published token ceiling moves.
- **One reading surface narrows.** `lanes/skills.md` loses one pointer and one no-copy bar. Graded in ④ as N1.

### ② Semver level

- **`skip-changeset` is right: nothing is released.** The diff is two `.claude/**` instruction files and a comment in a repo script. The root manifest is private, and no package manifest references either path. The diff holds no `.changeset` file. `Check Changeset` concluded success.
- **`Clause-②: no` stands.** Nothing widens a published accept-set or enlarges a public surface. Nothing narrows one either, so no `(narrowing)` arm is owed.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none` stands.** No `packages/spec` path is in the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** empty in dev report 6845919336. Nothing to answer.
- **Out-of-scope note 1, table-row pin headroom 2:** confirmed. The widest table row in the retirement playbook is 324 bytes at L86 on both `main` and the head, against a pin of 326. It predates this PR, and lowering the pin is optional. Accepted, no carrier.
- **Out-of-scope note 2, a line holding only 「是」:** confirmed at L30 of the retirement playbook. Merging it would be a re-wrap, so leaving it was correct. Accepted, no carrier.
- **Claimed file surface:** held. Three files, all named in claim 6845512565, and the script hunk changes no logic.
- **Local gate note** (`check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3, then 0 after a build): a local-run detail. The head's check-runs are the verdict.
- **Check-runs on the head, read 2026-11-13T06:44Z:** 49 in total, all concluded. 26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed, 0 running. The successes include `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and all eight `Lint ·` checks, `TypeScript Type Check` and all four `Type Check ·` checks, `Test Core` and its shards 1/8 and 2/8, `Test UI` and `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Whether each skip is an expected one is the seat's read before landing.
- **Tier:** both governed paths in the file list are under `.claude/**`, which the register lists as Tier S for this repo. No Tier H path is in the file list.
- **Author:** `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no off-relay author note is owed.
- **`Fixes` on the decision card:** right. The ruling's work (the lane text and the script header) and the carrier note's playbook repair are all in the diff.
- **Escalations:** none.

### ④ Design judgment

#### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md`

New clause, L16: 「枚举行撞 token 上限:同 PR 按该行实测增量抬上限,⛔ 不削他文、不夹带;正文引两条裁决。」

| Ruling A on #32673 (record 6840575378) | The clause | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| "may raise that skill file's token cap by the row's measured delta, and by no more" | 「同 PR 按该行实测增量抬上限」, closed by 「不夹带」 | same |
| "Nothing else in the file is cut to make room" | 「⛔ 不削他文」 | same (see N2) |
| "no wider raise rides along" | 「不夹带」 | same |
| "The PR body cites ruling A and this ruling" | 「正文引两条裁决」 | same |

- **No wider.** 「枚举行」 is the term L14–15 define for the key-adding exception, and 「同 PR」 points back at L14's PR. The gates force a new key's or member's row into the PR that adds it, so no other kind of PR adds such a row. Bound-member rows are inside the ruling: the card's premise lists the two enumeration files at headroom 0.
- **No narrower.** No bound of the ruling is dropped.
- **The two rulings are not named in the clause,** which id-lint requires. They are named, with record ids, in the header of the script whose `CEILINGS` row the raise edits, so the dev making the raise and the seat reviewing it both have them open.
- **No conflict with its neighbours.** L14 「同笔只加枚举行」 governs `skills/**`, and the ceiling row is in `scripts/`. L17 bars internal rules, `scripts/pm/**` among them, from product PRs, and the token ratchet is not under that path. L18 asks for a decision card before a ceiling rule changes, and this one had its card.
- **id-lint shape:** no issue number, date or quotation in the new or edited lines. The clause is one sentence, found by `grep "token 上限"`, at 119 of 120 bytes.

Line accounting, 35 → 35. One whole line is deleted (L9 on `main`, 118 bytes) and one is added (119 bytes). The header line is edited in place (103 → 114 bytes) and no line break moves. The new line is paid by deletion, not by a re-wrap.

The deleted line, 「全量判据在 SKILL.md 域车道表;受管面定义与两层分档见 SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉,⛔ 不另抄。」, carried three things:

1. The pointer to the domain-lane table. It survives in the header: 「见 seat-lifecycle.md 与 SKILL.md 域车道表」.
2. The pointer to 〈路径分叉〉 for the governed-surface definition and the two tiers. It is gone from this file. The content it pointed at is intact in SKILL.md (heading L179, surface list L183–185, two tiers L202) and in AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14.
3. The bar 「⛔ 不另抄」 on copying either into this file. It is gone from this file.

The cut loses nothing a reader needs in order to act. Every reader of a lane file is a seat session that has read SKILL.md in full, and L24 still names the instrument that answers a path's tier.

**N1 (nit).** Items 2 and 3 no longer have a home in this file. The header is also not quite the `lanes/ui.md` shape the PR body describes: it has no 「范围」 and no row name. A copy of either definition into this file is still priced by its ceiling at zero headroom and by L33 「无具名读者的新增是 token 税」. If the seat wants the line back, the ruled clause was eligible for a +1 ordinary raise under the line ratchet's ruling-of-record path (ruling record 6184799323), so the cut was a choice.

**N2 (nit).** 「他文」 can be read as "other documents", because 「本文」 in L3 means this document. The ruling bars cutting other text in the same file. L14 「同笔只加枚举行」 and the script header ("Nothing else in the file is cut to make room") close both readings, so no behaviour changes. The line has one byte of room.

#### `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`

New line, L295: 「例外:改名替代者是顶层键或所绑活成员 ⇒ 其枚举行随退役 PR,上限照 `lanes/skills.md`。」

- **Consistent with `lanes/skills.md` L14–16.** Same two kinds of row, additions only, and the ceiling rule is deferred to the lane file instead of restated.
- **Consistent with ruling A on #32584.** Only the replacement's row rides. The item's default, 「另立 `domain:skills` 卡,⛔ 不进退役 PR」, still governs everything else, the old name's row included.
- **Holds against the gate it leans on.** `check:skill-top-level-keys` reconciles in both directions, and the playbook's own line says a tombstoned top-level key still counts as declared. A rename by tombstone is therefore red until the replacement's row is in the same PR. That is the fail-closed conflict the carrier note describes, and this line resolves it.
- **「顶层键」 without 「可编写」 is not wider.** A machine-written replacement has no enumeration row (it takes a `NOT_AUTHORED` entry), so 「其枚举行」 has nothing to refer to.

Line accounting, 337 → 337. The line is paid by deleting this sentence from the Docs item: 「release notes 在发布时从 changesets + D2/D3 registry 集中编写,你的 changeset(下一项)才是通往它们的输入。」

- **The cut has a home.** AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails, the `content/docs/releases/` row (L645), says: "Release notes are written centrally at release time, compiled from changesets + the ADR-0087 registries … Your PR's input is its changeset; for spec removals also the D2/D3 registry entries." That is the deleted sentence and more. The Docs item still cites that section, and the Changeset item still follows it.
- **The re-flow buys no line.** The deleted sentence is 120 bytes without its spaces, more than the 114 a continuation line holds after its six-space indent. Deletion alone, joined at the cut with no other break moved, gives lines of 86, 79, 66 and 113 bytes: four lines. The PR's re-flow gives 86, 79, 108 and 71: also four, against five on `main`. With whitespace removed, the head's paragraph is byte-identical to `main`'s minus that sentence. The one moved break sits between two Han characters before and after, so the rendered text does not change. The paragraph's first two lines stay as loose as on `main`.

**N3 (nit).** The line names `lanes/skills.md` by its short path, from a different skill's directory. It resolves to exactly one file in the tree, so nothing breaks. The line is at 118 of 120 bytes.

#### `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (header only)

- **It changes no logic.** All nine added lines are inside the header comment.
- **It agrees with what the script does.** The script compares a count with a ceiling and cannot read a diff or a ruling. The bullet above the new one already says the seat's contract-review record checks the deletion and the quote. The new bullet adds a case checked the same way and claims nothing for the script.
- **It agrees with both rulings.** Each is named with its record id. The maintainer's words 「32843 32673 同意」 are verbatim and untranslated. The four bounds follow record 6840575378 nearly word for word. The rename sentence states a case the card put to the maintainer, not a new one.
- **It agrees with the two `.claude` files.** Same scope, same bounds, same rename case.

**N4 (nit).** "One standing case of that last clause" points at the wrong clause if read literally. The last clause of the bullet above is "The script cannot read diffs or rulings…". The clause meant is "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta". In the same sentence, "raise that file's row by the row's own measured delta" uses "row" for the ceiling row and for the enumeration row. Both resolve from context.

#### Read outside the diff, not graded

- **The gate's over-ceiling message does not know the new case.** That message (L1715–1730, pinned by the self-test at L2154–2170) still names only the delete-restatement path, and the header keeps "ONE gate-recognised path", which stays true for that reason alone. A dev on a key-adding PR who meets the red gate is told to delete text in the same file, which both rulings bar for that PR. The standing case reaches that dev only through the header and the lane text. It fails closed at review, at the cost of a round. The claim bars a logic change and the ruling's work line names the header, so this is outside this PR. A follow-up card is the seat's call.
- **`execution-duties.md` L111 says 「派发令文件面只点该行」.** A dispatch order for a row that will hit its ceiling also needs the `CEILINGS` row in its file surface, or a dev that stops on breach will stop. The line already points at `lanes/skills.md`, which now carries the clause. The seat's call.

Nits alone, so the round ends here.
